description: Prompt → curated startup list. Pass a natural-language brief like 'stealth AI agent startups in Israel founded after 2024' and the engine runs a Google-grounded search, parses results, finds-or-creates the matching startup rows in StartupHub.ai's database, and returns up to 50 startup IDs. Caller can then hand those IDs to a separate /lists/submit call to publish the list as a public, indexed page. Useful workflows: (1) build a portfolio-style page from a prompt without manual curation, (2) extract a list of companies from raw text (paste a YC batch page, a16z portfolio, CSV: set 'pasted_list' instead of 'prompt'), (3) regularly refresh a 'who's new in X sector' list via cron. Each call costs 5 credits (Pro Lite=15/day, Pro=50/day). Returns the matched startups (id/name/slug/logo) plus a 'created' count showing how many were brand new in our DB. Needs a free StartupHub.ai account.

pasted_list.description: Raw text containing company names (YC batch page, portfolio listing, article, CSV). Names + context will be extracted automatically. Use this instead of 'prompt' when you already know the companies and want them structured.

prompt.description: Natural-language brief, e.g. 'AI coding agents that raised seed funding in 2026' or 'European fintech-AI startups with ex-Stripe founders'. Required unless 'pasted_list' is provided.
